label: input token p at original position >= 4
explanation: Fires when the input token is the letter p during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at position t >= 4. It never fires on p at positions 0-3, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (including when p is fed back as a copied input), and essentially never on any other token. Within the original phase the rate is flat at about 3.3% of steps for t = 4..8, which matches the frequency of p. Magnitude grows with position: about 0.1 of max at t = 4, about 0.43 at t = 5, about 0.65 at t = 6, and about 1.0 at t = 8. It depends on absolute position, not on L or distance to <DEL>. Preceding tokens and whether p appeared earlier have little effect.

issues: The test split confirms the reported scores: precision 1.0 with 0 false positives, recall 0.9986, F1 0.9993, mass recall 0.99995.

There are 57 missed activations on test, all tiny (0.01-0.02 of max) and almost all on non-p tokens at original position 8 in L=9 sequences. They hold 0.0% of the activation mass, so this is scattered noise near a position boundary and not a meaningful class.

The dev profile backs the phase and position claims: activation is zero at the delimiter, zero in the copy phase (including copied p, e.g. 'g s u 1 n c e p' fires only on the original p), and zero at positions 0-3. The firing rate is 0.033 at every position from 4 to 8.

Magnitude by position, computed as activation-mass share divided by active count and set relative to t=8: about 0.12, 0.48, 0.76, 0.94, 1.0 for t=4..8. This roughly matches the explanation's figures (it says 0.65 at t=6; I get about 0.76).

The examples show magnitude tracks absolute position, not L: t=4 gives 0.10 at L=5 and 0.08 at L=8; t=5 gives 0.44 at L=6 and 0.42 at L=8. The skew in the L and to_go marginals comes from which positions exist in each length.

in_first does skew the dev profile (0.186 of mass on non-first occurrences, 0.814 on first). But every p at positions 4 and up fires (precision is 1), so earlier p's do not suppress the feature. 'Little effect' holds for whether it fires; how much repeats change magnitude was not measured.
